# Source

This plugin projects the first-party `dotnet` skill into a Codex marketplace pack.

## Boundary

- `dotnet` is first-party source custody under `skills/dotnet/`.

## Provenance

This plugin contains the first-party `dotnet` ecosystem skill in a Codex marketplace pack.

### Canonical source

- `dotnet` first-party skill: `skills/dotnet/`

### Pack shape

- Codex plugin root: `dist/plugins/dotnet-pack/`
- Skill root: `dist/plugins/dotnet-pack/skills/`
- Skills install from the Codex plugin root.

### Rights and Attribution

- `dotnet` content is MIT-licensed first-party.
